items.summary: Binance co-founder and co-chief executive Yi He said Kaiser Ng is leaving as chief financial officer after more than five years to pursue a new venture, with a transition plan that has been under way for about six months, according to The Block and The Globe and Mail. Justin Yek, previously vice-president of finance at Airwallex, is taking over as CFO. The announcement came days after the late-October theft from Binance; Yi He did not say the departure was caused by the incident.

items.summary: The Norwegian crypto exchange Firi recorded 19.8 million kroner in crypto trading the day after the Binance hack — more than double a typical day — according to figures Firi shared with E24. Activity stayed high over the weekend at 15.4 million kroner, 50 percent above the next-busiest weekend so far this year, chief executive Thuc Hoang told E24. Hoang says it is too early to know whether customers are permanently moving funds from foreign exchanges.

items.summary: Nordic ETP issuer Virtune listed its Virtune AI Crypto Index ETP on 3 November 2026 under the tickers VIRAI on Nasdaq Stockholm and VRTI on Deutsche Börse Xetra, according to Kaupr. The product tracks an index of 13 crypto assets linked to what the industry calls the agent economy. In an interview with Kaupr, Virtune chief sales officer Andreas Severin said the listing reflects the company's view that software agents using blockchain services are becoming a growth driver alongside tokenisation.

items.summary: The Norwegian crypto exchange Firi says the temporary lay-offs it announced in August will last until the end of March 2027, the maximum of 26 weeks allowed under Norwegian rules, chief executive Thuc Hoang told Kaupr. Hoang says trading activity in 2026 has been lower than the company had planned for. Firi has hired Dino Cehajic, previously at Eika, as chief product officer, and according to Kaupr three key employees have left for other jobs since September.

items.summary: Sweden's Economic Crime Authority has charged Valuno Group's former chief executive and a former finance director with aggravated insider trading, according to Kaupr and Kryptovalutaguiden. According to the prosecutor, the two learned on 3 July 2025 that Finansinspektionen had refused the subsidiary QB Europe a MiCA licence and sold large parts of their shares before the decision was made public on 4 July, after which the share price fell about 33 percent. Valuno says it is assisting the legal process as needed; no one has been convicted. The charged former chief executive is also a former leader of Medborgerlig Samling and denies wrongdoing, according to SvD; the case is Stockholm District Court B 16085-26.

items.summary: The Norwegian crypto exchange NBX has raised at least 34 million Norwegian kroner from the US investor LDA Capital through ten share issues since 2022, according to Kaupr's tally of the company's stock exchange announcements; the latest, closed on 3 November 2026, raised 6.8 million kroner at 0.47 kroner per share. According to NBX's announcements, the money has funded bitcoin purchases and the capital requirements for its e-money licence and its MiCA licence. Under the agreement, NBX decides when to draw on the facility.

items.summary: Goobit has signed an agreement with Kvarn Metals, which will be the counterparty for gold in its Futureproof savings platform, the company told Kaupr. According to Goobit, the gold is backed 1:1 by physical gold, while bitcoin comes from Kvarn Capital under an agreement made in September. Goobit says both asset classes it needs for launch are now in place.
